title: Listing Flags
description: Review reports submitted by users for inappropriate listings.

help.title: About Listing flags
help.overview: A listing flag is a moderation report: a user marks a listing as inappropriate, spam, misleading, or other, with an optional comment. Administrators review reports and decide them.

sections.title: Reporting
items: The reporter is whoever creates the flag. One live report per user and listing.
While pending, the reporter can still edit the reason and comment; the listing is fixed.
Reports are private: administrators see them all, everyone else only their own.

sections.title: Statuses and decisions
sections.body: Only an administrator can decide, only while the report is pending, and a resolution note is always required.
items: Resolve marks the report reviewed (upheld). Choose deactivate to take the listing offline at the same time, or none to keep it live.

sections.title: Deleting
items: Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored, unless the same user has since filed a new report on that listing.
